Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct level shift (anomaly) starting around x = 510. Before this point, the data fluctuates roughly between -5 and +10 mm. After this point, the data drops significantly and fluctuates roughly between -25 and -5 mm. This sustained change in the mean level constitutes an anomaly range.

The anomalous range appears to start at approximately **510** and continues to the end of the plotted data at **730**.

[[510, 730]]
